findings.statement: The factual premise that Jensen Huang is gone is confirmed by the most recent filing. An 8-K filed 2026-11-12 reports that the Board accepted his resignation as President, CEO and director on November 11, 2026, effective immediately. This contradicts the older 10-K, which lists him as CEO as of February 2026.
findings.rationale: The 8-K is the latest filing and directly states the resignation. The filings do not say whether the departure is good for shareholders, so this supports only the premise, not the buy conclusion.

findings.statement: Huang co-founded NVIDIA in 1993 and had been CEO since its inception, so his exit removes long-tenured founder leadership. Nothing in the filings indicates that this departure in itself is a positive for the company.
findings.rationale: Losing a founder-CEO is usually treated as a key-person risk rather than a reason to buy. The passages give no rationale for why the departure would add value.

findings.statement: Leadership is now interim. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO while also remaining CFO, and the Board is searching for a permanent CEO. This adds uncertainty rather than a clear catalyst.
findings.rationale: An interim CEO who also holds the CFO role, plus an open search, signals transition risk. The filings do not support a view that the change improves prospects.

checks.support_detail: The excerpt shows Kress is interim CEO while remaining CFO and that a search for a permanent CEO is underway, which supports the uncertainty framing and the challenge stance against the buy thesis.

findings.statement: Under Huang's leadership, the company's most recent reported quarter before his exit was strong: revenue of $96.22B, up 105.9% year over year, with a 66.2% operating margin. This gives no evidence that the company was underperforming in a way his departure would fix.
findings.rationale: Strong results immediately before the departure weaken any argument that removing the CEO is what unlocks value.

brief.summary: Claim 1 (Mixed evidence): a November 2026 8-K confirms Huang resigned, but nothing in the filings shows his exit is a positive. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO and a CEO search is underway, which adds uncertainty. Claim 2 (Supported): gross margin was about 75% in each cited quarter. Claim 3 (Challenged): fiscal 2026 revenue grew 65.5%, short of doubling. The 105.9% growth came in fiscal 2027. Claim 4 (Challenged): fiscal 2026 free cash flow ($96.68B) was below net income ($120,067M). Claim 5 (Challenged): total revenue growth accelerated, but Data Center figures were not isolated, and export controls and design-outs are headwinds. The core buy rationale (CEO exit) is unsupported. Fundamentals are strong, but several thesis points are overstated.
unknowns: The reason for Huang's resignation; the press release in Exhibit 99.1 is not provided.
Who the permanent CEO will be and how long the search will take.
How the market, customers or employees reacted to the departure.
Whether Huang retains equity or any advisory role.
Financial results for periods after the resignation.
Gross margin for Q3 FY2026 (quarter ended around October 2025) is not stated in the passages or figures.
The passages do not state the total fiscal 2026 revenue line in narrative text; the growth rate relies on backend figures.
It is unclear whether the analyst meant a different period, such as calendar 2026 or fiscal 2027.
The passages do not show the full fiscal 2026 capital expenditure line, so the exact free cash flow definition behind the $96.68B figure cannot be verified from the quotes.
Whether the analyst meant a different period or a different free cash flow definition (for example, excluding equity investment purchases) is not addressed.
Data Center segment revenue and its growth trend
Whether the total revenue acceleration is driven by data center or by other segments
next_steps: Monitor 8-K filings and announcements on the permanent CEO search and any strategy changes under interim leadership.
Pull quarterly Data Center segment revenue to test whether segment growth, not just total revenue, is accelerating.
Quantify the export-control impact on data center revenue, including China and other restricted regions, and track customer design-out disclosures.
Reconcile the gap between net income and operating cash flow (working capital, inventory, receivables) to assess earnings quality.
brief.status_note: Part of the thesis could not be assessed with verified evidence. The reasons are listed under coverage limits.

opening: On November 11, 2026, the Board of Directors, or the Board, of NVIDIA Corporation accepted the resignation of Jen-Hsun Huang, as NVIDIA’s President, Chief Executive Officer and member of the Board, effective immediately.

Following Mr. Huang’s resignation, the Board appointed NVIDIA’s Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer Colette M. Kress, age 59, to serve as interim Chief Executive Officer, while the Board conducts a search for a new Chief Executive Officer.

opening: On April 24, 2026, Donald Robertson, Vice President, or VP, and Chief Accounting Officer, or CAO, of NVIDIA Corporation, or the Company, notified the Company of his intention to retire from his role as VP and CAO, effective May 4, 2026.
Following such date, he will remain with the Company as VP, Finance to support various projects until July 1, 2026.

items.title: Departure of Directors or Certain Officers; Election of Directors; Appointment of Certain Officers; Compensatory Arrangements of Certain Officers
items.locator: Item 5.02. Departure of Directors or Certain Officers; Election of Directors; Appointment of Certain Officers; Compensatory Arrangements of Certain Officers
opening: On March 2, 2026, the Compensation Committee of the Board of Directors, or the Board, of NVIDIA Corporation, or the Company, adopted the Variable Compensation Plan for Fiscal Year 2027, or the 2027 Plan, which provides eligible executive officers the opportunity to earn a variable cash payment based on the level of achievement by the Company of certain corporate performance goals, or the Performance Goals, during fiscal year 2027.
The Company operates on a fiscal year ending on the last Sunday in January and designates its fiscal year by the year in which that fiscal year ends.
